question: Which of the following teams did NOT qualify for the playoffs of the 15th edition of Indian Premier League?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai Indians.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mumbai Indians** did **not qualify** for the playoffs of the 15th edition of the** Indian Premier League.**
 
• Teams that played in the playoffs were **Gujarat Titans, Rajasthan Royals, Lucknow Super Giants and Royal Challengers Banglore.**
 
• The 15th edition of Indian Premier League - TATA IPL 2022 began on** March 26, 2022.**
 
• The **Gujarat Titans won** their maiden title in their first season of the championship by **defeating Rajasthan Royals** by **7 wickets.**

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IPL, or the Indian Premier League**, was started in **2008 **by the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).**
 
• The inaugural season of IPL took place from **April to June 2008**.
 
• It was the **first professional cricket league **in the world to introduce the **franchise model**.
 
• The **Indian Premier League (IPL) 2022**, was the **15th edition** of the professional Twenty20 cricket league.
 
• IPL 2022** Sponsorer was TATA**. IPL 2022 Champion Title **won by Gujarat Titans.**
 
• The **Orange Cap** title winner is **Jos Butler (Rajasthan Royals)** with Total runs:** 863 runs.**
 
• The** Purple Cap **title winner is **Yuzvendra Chahal (Rajasthan Royals)** with total **27 Wickets.**
